Hi Amina — thanks for your time last week. I know we missed connecting for the live deep-dive scheduled earlier today; I wanted to get a short, focused session back on the calendar so we can cover the integration checklist and SSO/data residency items you flagged.

I can offer three condensed 30-minute windows this week (keeps the meeting tight, focused on tech & infra):
- Wednesday 11/18 — 09:00–09:30 PT
- Thursday 11/19 — 13:00–13:30 PT
- Friday 11/20 — 08:30–09:00 PT

Please confirm one of the three slots by EOD Monday (11/16). If I don’t hear back by then I’ll release the slots and offer the next available week — we have limited SRE/SE capacity this month.

Proposed 30m agenda (we’ll keep it technical):
1) Quick environment summary & required network egress (5m)
2) SSO/KMS/data residency Qs (10m)
3) Inference topology options & cost considerations (10m)
4) Next steps / MAP owner & doc handoff (5m)

Attached: short mutual action plan (MAP) draft and a one-pager on Redwood Dedicated. Monica (cc) will join to cover integration specifics.

Thanks — Sean

Perfect — locking Thursday 11/19 13:00–13:30 PT. I just sent a calendar invite with the short agenda and a Zoom link. Monica will walk through SSO attributes and network requirements; I’ll cover inference topology and cost tradeoffs.

Quick answers to your asks: 
- SE note: Redwood supports both SP- and IdP-initiated SSO. Typical required attributes: email, name, groups/roles, and an optional tenant_id claim. Monica, I’m handing to you to add any specifics.
- Attached a short security FAQ that outlines retention controls and export processes — if you want a formal doc for your security review I’ll pull the on-prem package list and a redlines-friendly excerpt this afternoon.

If anything changes before Thursday, reply here and I’ll reschedule. Looking forward to a focused 30m.

Thanks — Sean
